name: Lurker Rotary Phone #30
description:
A vintage rotary phone equipped with a reality-altering dial. Users report auditory hallucinations of voices and sounds from other dimensions when numbers are dialed, often inciting fear and paranoia. Prolonged exposure leads to increased disorientation and anxiety.

EFFECT: When dialed, the phone connects to unknown dimensions, projecting disturbing voices and sounds that induce paranoia.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Activates interdimensional communications that produce hallucinatory and unsettling auditory phenomena.
TASTE: N/A
PACKAGING: A small, rectangular cardboard box with faded colors and retro-styled graphics featuring a rotary phone surrounded by cryptic symbols. The packaging reads "Lurker Rotary Phone - Listen Closely" and displays undecipherable glyphs.

RESEARCHER NOTE: Clearly, calling long-distance has a whole new meaning here.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-11-26 — edition #30 of the permanent record.
